name: A fourth accrual adds exactly one liability per responsible debtor
title: SC-13-02-09 A fourth accrual adds exactly one liability per responsible debtor
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When the manager accrues period "Aralık 2026" due "2026-12-10"
Then every unit A-1 to A-6 gains exactly one liability and A-7 gains none
And a repeated accrual of "Aralık 2026" adds nothing
And the ledger invariants hold
